name: 06855 · Norwalk, CT
findings: ZIP 06855 (Norwalk) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06855 (Norwalk) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06855 (Norwalk) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
